data.text: Good! I can see that `order_reviews` has a `review_comment_message` column which is optional (59% nulls). Let me query to count how many reviews have a non-null comment message.

args.purpose: Count reviews with and without written comment messages
args.sql:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_reviews,
  SUM(CASE WHEN review_comment_message IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as reviews_with_message,
  SUM(CASE WHEN review_comment_message IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as reviews_without_message,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN review_comment_message IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) as pct_with_message
FROM order_reviews
